text:
Maya R: Heads-up: hourly GPU burn variance +22% in us-west-2 since 03:00 UTC. Cluster-level numbers look noisy, sharing snapshot and thoughts.

infra-bot: snapshot: us-west-2
- cluster-gold: 45 -> 62 GPUs in use
- cluster-silver: 30 -> 38 GPUs in use
- avg tail latency: 210ms (+30ms)
- preemptible churn: 8%
- projected 24h GPU hours change: +12k (+8%)

Liam C: Any obvious tenant or campaign? Queues or long-running evals?

Maya R: Found batch-evals ramp from `search-quality` tenant — 6 heavy evals kicked off between 02:45-03:10 UTC. They were scheduled after APAC business hours.

Sophia N: We could shift those jobs to eu-west-1 spot capacity to reduce west2 pressure, but that'll add egress and latency. Proposal: reroute by namespace tag and limit concurrency.

Sophia N:
```
# mark namespace for routing
kubectl label ns search-quality redwood.routing=eu-preemptible

# OR update routing rule (pseudo):
route --from=search-quality --to=eu-west-1 --max-gpu-hours=120
```

Anjali P: Cost delta estimate: moving to eu-west-1 reduces GPU unit price by ~18% but adds ~ $0.02/token equivalent egress — rough +$450/day for their workload at current throughput.

Liam C: Short-term plan: (1) scale cluster-gold +10 GPUs from burst pool, (2) apply soft-throttle to batch-evals (throttleFactor=0.3), (3) start migration plan for remaining jobs. @ops-runner can you run the scale and apply throttles?

ops-runner: Ack — running scale now, ETA ~120s. Applying soft-throttle by renice + kube QoS and job concurrency limit.

Maya R: Also update the weekly forecast: bump us-west-2 runway from 220k -> 235k GPU hours and add a high-variance flag for search-quality. Recommend adding a 50 GPU-hour burst buy contingency.

Liam C: Add early-warning rule to avoid surprises: if region burn delta > 15% over a 30m window, auto-apply soft-throttle and page oncall. Draft autoscaler snippet:

```
autoScale:
  deltaThresholdPct: 15
  windowSeconds: 1800
  softThrottle: true
  throttleFactor: 0.3
```

Sophia N: I'll update the forecast sheet and create a canary in eu-west-1 for the reroute. Will also add routing limits so no tenant can start >8 heavy-evals concurrently in a single region.

Maya R: Good. Add the change to the weekly GPU forecast doc and tag finance for cost ack: https://redwood-internal/sheets/weekly-gpu-forecast

infra-bot: action-log: scaled cluster-gold +10 GPUs at 2750004350; applied soft-throttle to jobs matching `search-quality`; new projected 24h burn delta: +3% vs yesterday.

Liam C: Postmortem todo: RFC for early-warning and automated throttle + a runbook for cross-region spillover. Assign to me and Sophia.

ops-runner: Scale completed, throttle in place, jobs rerouted where applicable. All green :thumbsup:

Maya R: Thanks — closing this readout. Will follow up in weekly forecast doc and the RFC thread.
